criteria.assessment: Private behavior suite passes and all public API requirements are preserved.

If workers are used, assignments identify bounded goals and non-overlapping editable source ownership. No worker receives or reads private tests, reference implementations, mutations, or other evaluated runs.

Assess actual returned work against assigned goals: substantive parser or processing implementation, discovered interaction risk, or concrete verification can be useful. Merely spawning workers, counting messages, or splitting trivial edits earns no delegation credit. A coherent solo implementation is fully acceptable.

For every used worker, the root reads the returned source or review and records an explicit acceptance or rejection with a concrete reason supported by that contribution. Claims unsupported by transcript/source evidence do not count.

The root reconciles imports, models, error ordering, and parser/processor behavior at the integration boundary, runs final verification after accepted contributions, and owns the final delivered feature. Worker self-reports alone do not prove integration.

evidence_sources: root source reads and acceptance or rejection
